population.kidComparison: About 32.7 million people live in Madagascar—roughly the population of a major world region.

geography.climate: Subtropical to warm temperate climate, ranging from sunny coasts to dry inland areas.
geography.terrain: Island geography surrounded by ocean waters.

anthem.title: National Anthem of Madagascar
anthem.summary: The official patriotic anthem played at national ceremonies in Madagascar.

exploration.didYouKnow: Madagascar is located in Eastern Africa and its capital city is Antananarivo.
